build._comment_buildArgs: BUILD_COMMIT is surfaced via /health.commit so the CI health-gate can assert commit == github.sha. Railway interpolates $RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA at build time. RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA is ALSO injected as a runtime env var, so health.py reads it directly; this buildArg makes the OCI label correct + caches a copy in BUILD_COMMIT ENV for diagnostic dumps.
